meta.title: About Us | QUANTA
meta.description: We are a {teamCountWord}-person software studio that blends design and engineering into one practice. Learn about our philosophy, stack, and values.

hero.body: QUANTA is a {teamCountWord}-person digital product studio. We combine design, engineering, quality assurance, and cloud infrastructure into one tight-knit squad, because the best software happens when everyone owns the outcome.

why.title: Why we exist.
paragraphs: We started QUANTA because we were tired of the bloated agency model: endless management layers, misaligned incentives, and decks that looked great but collapsed when deployed to production.

We built a studio small enough that every person is essential, but experienced enough to own systems end to end. {TeamCountWord} people covering frontend, UI/UX design, backend architecture, and QA/DevOps.
No middle management. No handoffs. Designers and engineers working side by side from the first prototype to the final deployment.

items.title: Craft over volume
items.description: We take on fewer projects to give each one the attention it deserves. Every detail matters — from the first line of code to the final pixel.

items.title: Clarity in complexity
items.description: Good software makes complex things feel simple. We reduce friction, strip away unnecessary layers, and build interfaces that explain themselves.

items.title: Direct collaboration
items.description: No account managers, no handoffs. You work with the people building your product — designers and engineers who understand the full picture.

items.title: Shipping matters
items.description: Ideas are free. Execution is everything. We plan, build, test and deploy with the same level of care across every stage.

items.title: Discover
items.description: We start by understanding your business, goals, and constraints. We ask hard questions early so we don't build the wrong thing.

items.title: Design
items.description: From wireframes to high-fidelity prototypes, we define the experience before writing a single line of production code.

items.title: Develop
items.description: Frontend and backend work in parallel. TypeScript, modern frameworks, clean architecture — built to scale, built to last.

items.title: Deliver
items.description: QA, performance testing, deployment pipelines. We don't just hand off code — we launch products and stand behind them.
